note: Rejudged 2026-10-31 by an auditor who authored none of the change. The only change to test/plugin/peer-open-role-complement.ci and role-mismatch-notification.ci since the last stamp is cabb706c11 moving the policy block from inside bgp {} to the top-level policy root, the same lines re-indented; every action, expect, reject and option line is byte-identical, so the carriers drive the same inputs and assert the same outcomes. Verdict unchanged. RFC 9234 Section 4.2: "If the Roles do not correspond, the BGP speaker MUST reject the connection using the Role Mismatch Notification (code 2, subcode 11)." Producer role/validate.go::validateOpenRolePair checks Table 2; server/validate.go::askOpenValidators converts a rejected ValidateOpenOutput into OpenValidationError and reactor/session_open_validation.go::runOpenValidator sends its codes. role-mismatch-notification.ci supplies Provider/Provider and requires exact FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF001503020B, rejecting EoR; peer-open-role-complement.ci changes the remote role to Customer, requires EoR and rejects 03020B. TestValidateOpenRolePair_ValidPairs and InvalidPairs pin accept/refuse and exact codes; TestValidateOpenRolePairRunsForADynamicGroupMember also checks group lookup, refusal and complementary acceptance. Server TestBroadcastValidateOpenRefusesAnUnansweredPerPeerPolicy, TestAskOpenValidatorsLeavesASilentPluginPending and TestBroadcastValidateOpenAcceptsAPeerWithNoPerPeerPolicy retain the owner-selected fail-closed plumbing: those are supplemental robustness evidence, not a claim that the RFC equates plugin silence with an observed role mismatch. Rejudged independently against RFC source and every tagged carrier on 2026-10-22. Functional judgments use the corresponding test/draft/plugin files, not the unpromoted old-syntax live files. Their inactive NO-TRANSIT import/export policies explicitly end in accept; reactor runEgressPolicyChain applies that final only after mandatory in-process OTC, and OPEN validation is independent. This is a source judgment, not a new runtime or discrimination result; parent owns promotion and native freshness before stamping.
